title: DataTraceability
description: ISO 25012-sourced data quality archetype — Traceability inherent-and-system data quality characteristic. The degree to which data has attributes that provide an audit trail of access to the data and of any changes made to the data in a specific context of use. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms governing data entities. Source: ISO/IEC 25012 (Inherent and System-Dependent Data Quality — Traceability).

traceabilityLevel.description: Required traceability depth. NONE = no tracking. BASIC_LOGGING = access/change timestamps. CHANGE_TRACKING = who/what/when for each change. FULL_LINEAGE = complete provenance chain from source through all transformations.

lineageDepth.description: How far back in the data supply chain lineage must be traceable.

retentionPeriod.description: How long traceability records must be retained. ISO 8601 duration.
